sources.entry: babel - An internationalization library for Python.

summary.one_liner: Babel is a Python library of utilities for internationalizing and localizing Python applications, especially web-based ones.
summary.what_it_does: Babel is described as an integrated collection of utilities that help internationalize and localize Python applications. The README points to HTML documentation in a docs folder and to the project website for more information. It also links to a CONTRIBUTING guide for people who want to contribute code. The README itself is short and does not list specific features, functions, or APIs. Details beyond the general description are not included in the README text provided.
use_cases: adding translations to a Python web application
localizing Python app text for different languages
formatting locale-specific data in Python programs
notable: Integrated collection of i18n and l10n utilities for Python
Documentation kept as HTML files in the docs folder
Listed in awesome-python under Text Processing
caveats: README is brief and gives no install or usage instructions
Specific features are not described in the README; see the docs folder for details
